{{Top|leg}}
'''Holovision goggles''' were used to remotely view footage from a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]]. While the holocam could not be moved, the user could switch between multiple holocams that were set up, expanding their view of an area.

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] wore a pair of these [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] while in the [[Wlesc]] neighborhood of [[Pesktda]] on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. They enabled him, [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], [[Ganner Rhysode]], and the [[Resistance (Garqi)|Resistance]] to gain intel on the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|Yuuzhan Vong's]] [[Thrall]] training area there.
